C_C1, C_C2 Character vectors within-subject covariates (per condition). C Character vector -subject covariates. C_type Character; type C: "continuous" "categorical". W Character vector moderators. Default NULL. W_type Character; "continuous" "categorical". MP Character vector identifying regression paths moderated (example, "a1", "b_1_2", "cp"). form Model type: "P", "CN", "CP", "PC", "UD". Use "UD" specify user-defined mediation model. Na Missing-data method: "DE", "FIML", "MI". alpha Numeric vector (0, 1); two-sided significance levels. mi_args List MI-specific controls: m Number imputations. Default 5. method_num Imputation method mice(). decomposition Covariance-decomposition method     ("eigen", "chol", "svd"). pd Logical; positive-definiteness check. tol Tolerance positive-definiteness check. R Integer; number Monte Carlo draws. Default 20000L. bootstrap Integer; number bootstrap replicates (DE FIML ). boot_ci_type Character; bootstrap CI type: "perc", "bc", "bca.simple". iseed, seed Integer seeds bootstrap Monte Carlo, respectively. fixed.x Logical; passed lavaan. ci_method CI engine: "bootstrap" "mc". NULL (default) choice "bootstrap" Na = "DE" "mc" otherwise. MCmethod Na = "FIML" ci_method = "mc", choose "mc" (default) "bootSD". standardized Logical; TRUE, return standardized effects. Default FALSE. verbose Logical; print progress messages. paths character vector defining directed paths form = "UD". Paths specified using mediator labels M1, M2, , Y denoting outcome. example, c("M1 -> M3", "M3 -> Y", "M2 -> Y"). Must NULL predefined model forms.

title: Within-Subject Mediation Analysis (Two-Condition) — wsMed
text: Model structures: "P": parallel mediation "CN": chained (serial) mediation "CP": chained parallel "PC": parallel chained "UD": user-defined mediation model Missing-data strategies: "DE": list-wise deletion "FIML": full-information maximum likelihood "MI": multiple imputation via mice Confidence-interval engines: Bootstrap: percentile, BC, BCa (DE FIML ) Monte Carlo: draws via semmcci (Na options) Na = "FIML", may choose MCmethod = "mc" (default) "bootSD" add finite-sample SD correction. Workflow: (1) preprocess -> (2) generate SEM syntax -> (3) fit -> (4) compute confidence intervals -> (5) optional: standardize estimates.
